explication: This is the Kotlin programming-language repository, including compiler and IDE-facing analysis infrastructure. A typical compiler workflow accepts source and compiler arguments through a CLI pipeline, then performs frontend analysis and produces backend output; the tree also exposes FIR-based Analysis API services and incremental-compilation support. The excerpts show the CLI pipeline invoking its configured compound phase and FIR-to-IR declaration storage creating IR declarations through a generator. Other major stages and capabilities are represented from the tree, but their runtime wiring was not sampled, so speculative connections are omitted.
